findings.label: Webhook always ACKs 200 regardless of signature result
findings.detail: DodoWebhook in PaymentsController.cs discards the bool returned by ProcessDodoWebhookCommand and always returns Ok(new { received = true }). An attacker sending malformed payloads gets a 200 and can retry indefinitely. Fix: check the result and return 400 on false.

findings.label: Timing-safe comparison missing in HMAC verification
findings.detail: candidate == computedSignature in VerifyWebhookSignature uses ordinary string equality which short-circuits on the first mismatch, enabling a timing side-channel attack on the HMAC. Replace with CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(candidate), Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(computedSignature)).

findings.label: Mobile app placeClaim will break on deploy
findings.detail: rankup-mob/src/services/api.ts exports a placeClaim() function that POSTs to /api/claims, which now returns 410. No active call site was found in screens/, but the function is exported. Confirm the mobile app is retired or update it to use /api/payments/dodo/verify before deploying the backend change.

findings.label: quoteValidating signal is dead state
findings.detail: Set and cleared in proceedToCheckout() but never read by the template or any other binding after Task 10 replaced it with checkoutStage. Remove it to avoid confusion.

findings.label: appsettings.json secrets in diff
findings.detail: The file contains a plaintext DB password and Dodo test API key. This PR touches the file, surfacing both secrets in the commit diff. Rotate both values and move them to dotnet user-secrets or environment variables.

findings.label: Silent skip if production WebhookKey is blank
findings.detail: appsettings.Production.json ships WebhookKey as empty string. If the deploy pipeline omits the override, all webhooks are processed without signature verification. Add a startup guard or explicit fail-fast assertion to catch this misconfiguration.

findings.label: Audit log IsSuccess=true for payment.failed and payment.cancelled events
findings.detail: The PaymentAuditLog always sets IsSuccess=true after the event-type dispatch, including for payment.failed webhooks. Not a functional bug, but misleading to anyone querying the audit table for failed payments. Consider using IsSuccess=false for these event types.
